title: Windows Endpoint Performance & Reliability Troubleshooting (Boot, Profile, Crash, Disk)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (cross-domain endpoint troubleshooting/operations; diagnostic method + scripts, live-environment care).
Vendor/product-specific console internals are deferred to the vendor's official documentation; the Intune/Entra/Windows side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
hook: Turn a slow, crashing PC into a measured, fixed one
problem: “My computer is slow” is the ticket no one can quantify — slow boot, sign-in delays, crashes, disk pressure, or a runaway process. This toolkit gives you a measure-first root-cause method and diagnostic scripts for Windows performance and reliability in an enterprise fleet, so you turn a vague complaint into a measured cause (boot phase, profile load, resource pressure, crash/bugcheck, storage health) and a targeted fix.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the performance/reliability model (boot → sign-in/profile → steady-state resource use → stability), the signals to measure, and the root-cause tree.
Requirements Guide — what you need (endpoint access, Intune Endpoint analytics where available, event/log access) with how to verify each.
Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (slow boot, slow sign-in/profile, high CPU/RAM/disk, crashes/bugchecks, storage/SSD health) with the exact measurements and checks per branch.

5 PowerShell scripts — performance/reliability discovery, per-device measurement validation, a fleet performance/reliability report, safe remediation of common causes (startup, temp, profile), and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with measured pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices for baselining and repeatable performance triage.
short: A measure-first root-cause method and scripts for Windows performance and reliability — boot, profile, crashes, resource pressure, and disk health — turning “it's slow” into a measured cause and fix. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
